name: Home formation label matches a valid formation pattern and sums to ten
description: When the per-match lineups artifact is fetched, the home team's formation string matches the digits-and-hyphens pattern of a real football formation such as 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1, or 3-5-2, and its digits sum to ten outfield players.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Read the home.formation string from the lineups artifact
Verify the home.formation string matches the pattern of two to four hyphen-separated single digits, for example 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1, or 3-5-2
Verify the digits in the home.formation string sum to exactly ten
